faq.a: The Industrial Electronics Society, an IEEE technical society for electronics, control, communications, instrumentation and computational intelligence in industrial and manufacturing systems.

faq.q: What do I get as a member?
faq.a: Hands-on workshops (Arduino, PLC, MATLAB, power electronics), access to IEEE research, networking with engineers and alumni, industry visits, leadership experience, a stronger CV, help with research and publishing, and a community of people who build things.
Send the join form on this page. The committee reviews every request and replies by email.

faq.q: Where can I find chapter events?
faq.a: On the Events page of this site, and on Instagram at @ieee.ies.hu.
